Strategy: Target the third-loosest residual, aiming for a roomy bin while preserving the two loosest ones.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    second = max([x for x in bins if x < mx]) if len([x for x in bins if x < mx]) > 0 else mx
    third = max([x for x in bins if x < second]) if len([x for x in bins if x < second]) > 0 else second
    return [-abs(r - third) for r in bins]
```
